description: Shared-additive paths for the agent claim board (scripts/lib/agent_claim_board.py). Almost every PR adds one row or one entry to these files and the merge is mechanical, so a claim on one of them never conflicts with another session's claim, never blocks a claim/take/next, and never blocks a commit. Each entry must be an exact path (no globs). Remove an entry to make the path exclusive again; a missing or unreadable file means no shared paths (the safer, exclusive default). Doc: docs/ops/AGENT_CLAIM_BOARD.md (Shared-additive paths).

paths.reason: Generated index; every PR that adds a doc adds one row. Held exclusively it blocked agents for hours on 2026-10-23 (p3ui 16:32-18:32Z, then nvda-alert, with cio-quality, n8n-cutover and the backfill waiting).

paths.how: add your row to the relevant section; on a rebase conflict keep both sides' rows
paths.reason: Hand-maintained documentation index; PRs append one row each.

paths.how: the "build" line names NO test files: scripts/run-tests.mjs discovers every *.test.* under src/ (#2686). On a conflict take main's "build" line exactly and keep your other package.json changes. Never add a test name to it: a new test file runs because it exists; a dormant one is listed in scripts/tests.dormant.json
paths.reason: Until #2686 every UI PR appended its test to one shared "build" line, so each merge re-conflicted every open UI PR. On 2026-11-05 a 'keep both sides' resolution put 108 names back after #2686 and 27 PRs conflicted on this line alone.
